p1: Last night, I picked up the ghost of Miller's Bridge.
You know the legend. A woman in a white coat, soaking wet, asks for a ride home... then vanishes.
My radio was stuck on the same old song again. I didn't think about it.
She climbed in and gave me an address on Elm Street. She never once looked at me.
At the next light, I turned. The seat was empty. Just a puddle of water.
So I did what the legend says. I drove to the address and knocked.
An old woman opened the door. She looked right past me, at the empty porch.
Then she whispered... Every year, on this night, someone knocks.
Behind her hung a photo with a black ribbon. Twenty years old. My face.
The woman was never the ghost. She was bringing me home.
Follow. And never stop on Miller's Bridge.
